authorization: User requested further investigation of Conrad preprocessing/error assignments and testing whether they explain the Kprime discrepancy without excluding the three points.
scope: Conditional diagnostics only; no tuned weight search, replacement EOS or author-workflow claim.

Propagate printed Cij errors with zero covariance; no new uncertainty
Add independent per-point sigma_extra=0.005*KS in quadrature to formal KS errors; hypothetical
As above, fraction0.02; source-inspired by first-order2%KS change from a coherent1% velocity scaling at fixed density, but independent point errors are a hypothesis
Same2%KS amplitude, fully correlated across the three pressures; generalized effective-variance IRLS using rank-one covariance addition; tests shared calibration rather than independent scatter

Assign sigmaP0.5GPa instead of S1s0.1GPa; explicit hypothetical sensitivity
Round derived KS to nearest0.1GPa, keep formal errors unchanged; diagnostic tabulation-precision control

Same density recalculation using Table6 C44 and Table4 calculated [100]vs; bracket channel-dependent inference from rounded velocities

fixed_background: All219 rows retained in every case, including the three selected Conrad KS points and all other estimated errors. Keep7.7/10GPa excluded as previously confirmed from AngelFig3. No observations, pressure calibration or source coefficients edited.
source_findings: Conrad1999 p378 gives KS=(C11+2C12)/3; p377 describes Christoffel velocity inversion; Table6p379 gives formal Cij errors with unknown covariance.
Conrad1999 p377 reports assumed1%velocity precision, which does not supply per-point KS errors or their cross-pressure covariance.

Angel2022 p4 explicitly says no KS preprocessing by rescaling; adiabatic-isothermal conversion occurs inside EosFit(p6). No external KS-to-KT conversion or undocumented pressure correction is accepted as source processing.
Jiang2004 paragraph17 identifies possible orientation errors in Conrad, not a numerical correction or a quantified Conrad error model.
density_qualification: Calculated velocities are printed to0.01km/s; infer rho bounds from v+/-0.005 rounding only, not experimental standard errors. Reference density3.60g/cm3 is reported Table2. Density-reprocessing controls do not propagate the unknown density/correlation errors and cannot independently validate the published EOS they use.
shared_error_protocol: At each IRLS outer step, use the existing diagonal effective pressure variances for all rows, and add uuT on the3Conrad block with u_i=(dP/dKS)_i*0.02*KS_i. Freeze the block during each least-squares iteration. Whiten using its lower Cholesky factor. Keep all other weights unchanged. Covariance uses whitened pressure derivatives at final weights.
compute_cap: Exactly26scientific cases, two unchanged starts each=52optimizations; max30IRLS steps,400evaluations each, unchanged tolerances. Verification may replay declared cases. No post-result error fractions, scales, subsets or pressure corrections added.
reporting: All input changes/error semantics, fitted parameters/nuisance scales, both starts, covariances, bounds/convergence, weighted residuals and correlated3x3blocks. Compare against source and previous baseline, not only closeness in Kprime. Distinguish central preprocessing from independent additional scatter and shared calibration.
preservation: Never replace canonical Conrad Cij-derived observations/errors, prior diagnostics or coefficients. No author contact, push, release or catalog changes.
